summary: subelements lookup parameters: list of dicts plus key, and skip_missing (default false) passed as a dict flag to skip records lacking the key.
questions: How do I avoid errors when some records don't have the subkey?

answer_card.title: subelements lookup parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_terms` (required): the list of dictionaries and the key to extract
- `skip_missing` (default false): pass as an optional dict, e.g. `{'skip_missing': True}`, to skip items missing the subkey instead of erroring
